added.description:
Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description

The Director, Advanced Product Engineering
will drive the development and delivery of advanced cooling solutions for probe card technologies. This role is responsible for defining technical vision and roadmap for thermal solutions, leading multiple engineering efforts, and ensuring alignment with product, manufacturing, and business objectives.

The individual will lead and scale a high-performing engineering team, develop critical capabilities, and drive innovation in cooling architectures for next generation semiconductor test systems. Success in this role requires a balance of deep domain expertise, organizational leadership, and the ability to influence across functions and levels.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the architecture, design, and development of cooling solutions for probe card technologies.
Define and own thermal technology strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned to business objectives.
Lead, develop, and scale a team of engineers.
Drive resource planning, prioritization, and organizational design to support product and technology goals.
Establish and track business and engineering Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and manage development programs using Product Life Cycle (PLC) methodology.
Develop and evaluate new concepts for heat removal, temperature uniformity, and thermal stability.
Ensure organization has the technical rigor to execute development and implementation of solutions for highly complex product and engineering challenges.
Technically lead and/or execute engineering projects and spearhead research and development of new technologies, as appropriate.
Lead escalation resolution for critical product and customer issues. Interface with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex engineering issues and meet customer commitments.
Collaborate with manufacturing to build prototypes, alpha and beta probe cards.
Drive continuous improvement across development process, manufacturability, and reliability. Own delivery of complex programs including schedule, cost, and technical performance outcomes.

Preferred Experience

MS or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field preferred; BS with significant relevant experience will also be considered.
10+ years of relevant experience in thermal management, electronics cooling, semiconductor equipment, or related advanced product development environments.
Demonstrated success leading engineering teams in semiconductor, electronics cooling, or related industries.

Skills

3D Modeling, Agile Systems, AutoCAD 3D, Business Acumen, Communication, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Cross-Functional Collaboration, Cross-Functional Leadership, Engineering Leadership, Error Budgets, FEA Software, Geometric Dimensioning And Tolerancing (GD&T), Heat Transfers, Interpersonal Communication, Leadership, MATLAB, Problem Solving, Product Development, Python (Programming Language), Semiconductor Manufacturing, SolidWorks, Technology Strategy Development, Thermal Management, Thermomechanical Processing

Education & Experience

Minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience in leadership roles, with a Bachelor’s degree; or 10 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 8 years experience; or equivalent experience | Required

Pay Range

$192,400.00 - $252,525.00

Pay Range Explained

This role in Livermore, California pays between $192,400.00 and $252,525.00 per year, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.

added.title: Executive Director, Application Development – Telematics (P&C Insurance Technology)
added.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

This is far more than an application development leadership role. It is an opportunity to help shape the future of how USAA understands risk, serves members, and competes in an increasingly data-driven insurance marketplace.

As Executive Director, Application Development - Telematics
, you will report directly to the AVP of P&C Policy Core Systems and Technical Services and lead a growing organization of approximately 45 employees and 50 contractor resources responsible for one of USAA's most strategically important and rapidly evolving technology capabilities. Reporting to Aaron Bend, AVP of Policy Core Systems and Technical Services, you will own the technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and future evolution of USAA's telematics ecosystem, helping transform vast amounts of driving behavior, connected vehicle, mobile application, and sensor data into actionable insights that improve pricing accuracy, claims outcomes, risk segmentation, fraud detection, member experiences, and overall business performance.

The timing of this opportunity is particularly compelling. Telematics has evolved from a niche capability into a foundational component of USAA's Personal Auto business. Today, telematics data influences pricing decisions on more than half of USAA's quoted and issued auto insurance policies, and the organization continues to invest aggressively in expanding telematics-driven capabilities across pricing, underwriting, claims, and member engagement. Through strategic partnerships with telematics providers, automotive OEMs, and leading technology partners, USAA is accelerating its ability to leverage real-time data to create a more personalized, proactive, and intelligent insurance experience.

The Executive Director will play a central role in advancing cloud-native technologies, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics to unlock new sources of business value from telematics data. The role will help expand the use of telematics beyond pricing and underwriting into areas such as claims automation, crash detection, first-notice-of-loss acceleration, risk prevention, and member engagement, while also supporting the long-term evolution of USAA's telematics platform and data ecosystem.

Looking ahead, this position offers the opportunity to influence how USAA evolves beyond traditional telematics into a broader connected ecosystem. As connected vehicles, smart devices, sensors, and Internet of Things technologies continue to reshape the industry, USAA is exploring new ways to leverage data to improve member outcomes across both Auto and Property insurance, including Connected Home capabilities designed to proactively help members prevent losses before they occur.

For accomplished technology leaders from leading insurers, telematics providers, connected vehicle platforms, mobility technology companies, or other data-driven organizations, this represents a rare opportunity to move beyond managing an established program and help define the future direction of an increasingly strategic enterprise capability. The successful candidate will influence multi-year business and technology roadmaps, partner directly with senior leaders across technology and the business, and help determine how telematics, artificial intelligence, and emerging data ecosystems shape the future of insurance at USAA.

Few opportunities offer this combination of strategic visibility, technical complexity, business impact, and innovation. The work spans cloud modernization, AI, machine learning, mobile technologies, data engineering, vehicle integrations, digital experiences, pricing, underwriting, claims, and connected-device ecosystems, all within an organization making significant long-term investments in these capabilities.

For executives who are already successful and not actively considering a career move, this opportunity offers something increasingly rare: the chance to build and scale a transformative capability at an organization where telematics is already influencing core business decisions and is expected to play an even larger role in the future. The leader selected for this role will have a unique opportunity to help define how USAA leverages connected data, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to better serve millions of members and strengthen its competitive position for years to come.

Executive Directors in Application Development plan, coordinate, and supervise all activities related to the design, development, and implementation and maintenance of the organization's applications development and analysis function. These leaders also manage multiple development teams often supporting one or more lines of business or business functional areas. Additionally, these leaders work closely with clients in order to map and support their operational needs. These leaders are also responsible for developing, distributing, supporting, enforcing, and integrating best practices and technology standards across the organization, including ensuring all Information Technology General Controls, processes and procedures are followed as applicable and appropriate.

Location

USAA offers a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: Plano, TX (preference) or San Antonio, TX. Relocation assistance is available for this position.

What You'll Do

Perform workload management and prioritization duties in support of operations for the functional area assigned.
Apply subject-matter-expert functional knowledge to lead subordinate workers in producing work deliverables in support of departmental initiatives.
Develop functional policies, procedures and guidelines.
Identify opportunities and facilitates major improvements to processes and systems.
Ensure that the assigned application group develops processes and tools that contribute to the company business objectives.
Ensure that all application processes developed internally or by external service providers are conducted in line with corporate social responsibility, environmental and technical policies and applicable standards and legislation.
Oversee the assessment of the technical and business fitness of the application portfolio and their associated costs and risks In partnership with CTO, Infrastructure and IT Security, and ensure that the organization's applications are effectively secured and that risks are mitigated and comply with legal and corporate privacy and confidentiality rules.
Establish management routines to ensure appropriate oversight of the organization's software development and maintenance activities.
Serve as financial steward for the organization and manage relationships with major vendors and service providers to ensure they cost-effectively meet the needs of the organization.
Evaluate and select third party vendors to provide value added services.
Facilitate the contracting process through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) enterprise process.
Responsible for contract company/service performance providing timely feedback to ensure the best value for USAA.
Collaborate with CTO to ensure that solutions are consistent with technology standards.
Work across IT and business partners to reduce technical debt.
Collaborate with other leaders and/or stakeholders and develop an application development strategy that aligns with business strategy, adds value and is within budget constraints.
Responsible for team's adherence to SDLC and applicable controls.
Work to ensure teams have appropriate, development plans consistent with domain of expertise.
Mentor across the technical community.
Provide oversight to the engagement with the business DPO and ensure deliverables adhere to Agile practices / methodologies.
Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, I.S., or related field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
10 years of experience of general IT management competencies.
4 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and/or developing high-performing teams required.
Strong technical background of web-based application architecture, system and database architecture, security application integration and object-oriented languages in a large enterprise environment.
Experience in all stages of the SDLC: requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.
Experience collaborating with resources and stakeholders, influencing decisions and managing work to achieve strategic goals.
Experienced in vendor contract management and management of distributed development teams and resources.
Financial acumen involving budgets, forecasting, and executing on the budgets for applicable technology support function.
Understanding of relevant industry frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ITIL, SAFe, etc.)
Understanding of Legislative and Regulatory Compliance Requirements.
Experience overseeing the technology life cycle from requirements analysis, feasibility estimates, design, code, documentation, testing, implementation, and support.
Technical knowledge and understanding of technical domains that reside within Infrastructure Services, Security, Data or Application Development.
Experience conducting cost benefit analyses and leveraging results to drive technology support solutions.
Demonstrated thought leadership in embedding intuitive story telling of technology support functions including concise presentation of complex technical details.
Experience and ability to drive a culture of quality and personal accountability through technology support teams.

What Sets You Apart

5+ years of experience in behavior and usage-based insurance technology or telematics programs.
3+ years of experience modernizing legacy insurance systems to public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Domain experience with usage-based and behavior-based insurance, personal lines insurance, and personal lines claims.
Experience leading the technical strategy and delivery of telematics solutions for P&C, maintaining and building relationships with ecosystem partners, and translating telematic data into higher value using AI.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders in building multi-year roadmaps across P&C functional areas to advance the telematics architecture that supports multi-product capabilities.
Experience scaling data platforms that ingest massive telematics streams (e.g., Mobile app data, IoT device data, OEM vehicle data) and using near real-time data for multiple insurance use cases.
Experience building mobile app experiences tailored to telematic insurance programs.
Experience partnering with key industry telematic suppliers (e.g., CMT, Arity, Okto) or vehicle OEMs.
Experience using machine learning or advanced models to turn telematics data into risk scoring, analytical insights, pricing segmentation, claims detection, or customer engagement tools.
Experience leading the technical strategy to deliver telematic solutions at top insurance carriers.

The Vice President of Product & Platform Engineering will lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of the technology platforms that enable the company’s product operating model. This executive owns the end‑to‑end architecture across infrastructure, platforms, applications, and DevOps, ensuring that product squads/trios are fully enabled to build, deploy, and scale customer solutions with speed and autonomy.

They will develop a scalable, secure, and developer‑friendly platform ecosystem that accelerates innovation while maintaining reliability, performance, and operational excellence. As a hands‑on technical leader, the VP will bridge product strategy and engineering execution, providing the architecture, tooling, and infrastructure necessary to support modern product development and deliver scalable, resilient technology solutions.

Essential Responsibilities

Platform & Infrastructure Strategy

Define and lead the long-term platform engineering strategy supporting the organization’s product roadmap and growth.
Own the architecture and delivery of core platform capabilities, including infrastructure, developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and shared services.
Establish a scalable, resilient cloud architecture and infrastructure foundation.
Drive adoption of modern platform engineering practices such as internal developer platforms, platform-as-a-product, and self-service infrastructure.

Architecture Leadership

Own enterprise-level application and platform architecture.
Define standards for system design, microservices architecture, APIs, and data architecture.
Ensure platforms and services are designed for scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
Partner with product and engineering leaders to ensure architectural alignment across product squads.

Product Operating Model Enablement

Enable the organization’s product squad/trio operating model by providing shared platform services, architecture frameworks, and developer tooling.
Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, and Engineering leaders to ensure squads can build and deploy quickly without reinventing core capabilities.
Ensure teams have access to reusable components, APIs, and platform capabilities that accelerate delivery.

DevOps & Engineering Enablement

Own DevOps strategy, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering productivity tooling.
Drive improvements in developer experience, release velocity, and system reliability.
Lead adoption of observability, monitoring, and incident management practices.
Build a culture of automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement.

Reliability, Security, & Scalability

Ensure platform and infrastructure systems meet high standards of uptime, security, and compliance.
Partner with security and compliance teams to embed secure-by-design engineering practices.
Establish and maintain SRE and operational excellence practices.

Core Leadership Competencies

Strategic Mindset

Leads long‑term platform and architecture strategy aligned to product and business growth.
Bridges product strategy with engineering execution and platform enablement.

Ensures Accountability

Owns end‑to‑end architecture, platform, and DevOps delivery.
Sets and enforces standards for performance, security, reliability, and operational excellence

Builds Effective Teams (Builds & Coaches Effective Leadership Teams)

Builds and develops high‑performing engineering and platform teams.
Coaches leaders and fosters a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.

At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality. 

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm. 

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century. 

We are looking for a  Senior Manager, Engineering & Technology Finance
to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies.  This role will report to  
our Senior Director, Services Finance

and based in  San Jose, CA
.
  This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week
. 

Role Summary

The Senior Manager, Engineering & Technology Finance serves as a strategic partner to the CTO and Engineering leadership, enabling disciplined investment, financial transparency, and data-driven decision-making that bridges technical priorities with long-term corporate financial performance.

Location

This position is based in San Jose, CA. Travel is expected to be approximately 10%.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic partner to Engineering and Finance leadership within a high-growth, innovation-driven organization.
Support product roadmap and technical decision-making, evaluating trade-offs across cost, timeline, and resource allocation.
Provide clear financial framing for complex engineering and technology decisions, enabling informed prioritization.
Own annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range plan (LRP) for Engineering and Technology.
Build and maintain driver-based financial models linking headcount, development cycles, and output to business outcomes.
Ensure transparency into spend, pacing, and resource utilization, enabling proactive management of engineering investments.
Support capital allocation decisions across competing engineering initiatives, optimizing returns and resource deployment.
Develop ROI frameworks for new product development and technology investments, incorporating risk and uncertainty.
Quantify the financial impact of engineering decisions on margin, cost structure, and scalability.
Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain Finance on product cost, cost-down initiatives, and design-to-cost programs.
Ensure alignment between engineering investments and company-wide financial targets and performance objectives.
Maintain strong financial controls and compliance, including adherence to accounting policies, capitalization guidelines, and internal governance standards.
Drive improvements in financial systems, data quality, and reporting accuracy to enhance decision-making.
Implement tools and process enhancements to reduce manual effort and increase analytical depth.
Build scalable financial infrastructure to support rapid growth in engineering investment and organizational complexity.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive finance experience, with increasing scope and responsibility.
Experience supporting Engineering, R&D, or Technology organizations in a financial capacity.
Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Experience in manufacturing or capital-intensive industries preferred.
Proficiency with ERP and business intelligence tools (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau).

Competencies

Influential leader, able to drive alignment and decisions across broad cross-functional stakeholders.
Transparent communicator, operating with candor and sharing critical information proactively.
Strategic thinker, comfortable navigating ambiguity and prioritizing effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Highly collaborative, partnering across functions to solve problems and benchmark best practices.
High integrity and strong business judgment, with the ability to influence and negotiate within a complex, matrixed global organization.
